name: monkeycms
description: Monkey CMS is a simple, configurable API-based content management system (CMS), deriving its name from the Dutch pronunciation of 'API' as 'aapie'.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'bin/dist']) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && node scripts/build.mjs && tsc -p bin/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.pretest: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:components
scripts.serve: npm run build && node bin/dist/cli.js serve
